spec.description: Needs according psutil_* helper stored procedures installed on monitored Postgres DBs

spec.title: Host disk IO Totals ($agg_interval aggregate)
spec.description: For all disks on the host, not only Postgres related

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  max((data->>'read_bytes')::int8) - min((data->>'read_bytes')::int8) as "read_bytes",
  max((data->>'write_bytes')::int8) - min((data->>'write_bytes')::int8)  as "write_bytes"
FROM
  psutil_disk_io_total
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
) x WHERE read_bytes >= 0 and write_bytes >= 0
ORDER BY 1

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'idle')::float8) as "idle",
  avg((data->>'user')::float8) as "user",
  avg((data->>'system')::float8) as "system",
  avg((data->>'iowait')::float8) as "iowait",
  avg((data->>'other')::float8) as "other",
  avg((data->>'irqs')::float8) as "irqs"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: CPU utilization % ($agg_interval avg.)
spec.description: System-wide CPU utilization as reported by psutil.cpu_percent()

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'cpu_utilization')::float8) "utilization"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: System load ($agg_interval avg.)
spec.description: a.k.a. CPU run  queue length or Load Average, reported e.g. by the "uptime" command

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'load_1m_norm')::float8) "normalized to #CPU",
  avg((data->>'load_1m')::float8) "as reported by /proc/loadavg"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Memory usage ($agg_interval avg.)
spec.description: Doesn't have to necessarily equal 100%  to values reported by the "free" command - see [here](https://psutil.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#psutil.virtual_memory) for more

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'used')::float8) as "used",
  avg((data->>'total')::float8) as "total",
  avg((data->>'available')::float8) as "available",
  avg((data->>'free')::float8) as "free",
  avg((data->>'buff_cache')::float8) as "buff_cache"
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Swap usage ($agg_interval avg.)
spec.description: Doesn't have to necessarily equal 100%  to values reported by the "free" command - see [here](https://psutil.readthedocs.io/en/latest/#psutil.virtual_memory) for more

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  avg((data->>'swap_used')::float8) as "swap_used",
  avg((data->>'swap_total')::float8) as "swap_total"
FROM
  psutil_mem
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Disk usage %
spec.description: For Postgres data / WAL / log folder partitions and user defined tablespace partitions

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  (tag_data->>'dir_or_tablespace') || ' (' || (tag_data->>'path') || ')',
  avg((data->>'percent')::float8) as "percent"
FROM
  psutil_disk
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Disk space available
spec.description: For Postgres data / WAL / log folder partitions and user defined tablespace partitions

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $agg_interval),
  (tag_data->>'dir_or_tablespace') || ' (' || (tag_data->>'path') || ')',
  avg((data->>'free')::float8) as "free"
FROM
  psutil_disk
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname = '$dbname'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2
